text:
sofia: sharing a new mock for the private setup preflight. idea: run network checks first so users don't paste secrets before hitting infra issues. figma: https://figma.com/s/new-preflight
ken: big +1. fewer support tickets if we fail early. can we add a one-liner under the title: 'Why we run these checks' that links to docs?
mariah: copy suggestion: avoid 'allowlist' language. prefer 'Allowed IP ranges' and show an example: `10.0.0.0/24`. keep lines short.
gary: real-world note: public IP autodetect is unreliable behind some NATs. add an explicit checkbox: 'My deployment has a public IP' and a 'Troubleshoot NAT' link.
sofia: layout question: should preflight be an inline step or a collapsible side drawer? inline is simpler for keyboard users, but a side panel keeps the main wizard compact. thoughts?
ken: accessibility: accordion items must be buttons with `aria-expanded` states, failures announced via `role="alert"`. status chips need >=4.5 contrast or a non-color indicator.
mariah: failure messaging: short, actionable header then steps. e.g., 'Connectivity check failed. Try:' followed by 2-3 bullet fixes. no long paragraphs.
preflight-bot: running checks...
preflight-bot: ```
CHECK DNS_RESOLVE .......... OK
CHECK OUTBOUND_443 ........ WARN (handshake 580ms)
CHECK CIDR_ROUTE .......... FAIL (no route to 10.1.0.0/16)
CHECK TLS_VERIFY .......... OK
```
gary: suggestion: render each check with its own inline 'Fix' CTA that expands a tiny panel with a one-line remediation and an example command. this prevents scrolling.
sofia: agree. also we should show an 'Advanced diagnostics' collapsed block with raw curl/traceroute output and a 'Copy' button. keep it hidden by default.
ken: dev ask: can backend return structured checks: [{id, status, message, remediation_url, raw_output_url}]? makes UI simpler.
mariah: keyboard flow: when checks finish and there are failures, focus should go to the first failing check. screenreader should read the failure heading.
sofia: color/accessibility: our amber (#ff9800) doesn't meet contrast for body text. recommend #b86b00 or add an icon/label so color isn't the only cue.
gary: add a short error code for each failing check to help support (e.g., PREFLT_02_CIDR). include it in the UI and in exported logs.
mariah: copy tweak for ports: 'Allow outbound TCP port 443 (HTTPS)' instead of 'Open port 443'. more explicit for infra folks.
sofia: question about showing remediation inline vs a help center link — prefer inline examples of commands for common infra (AWS, GCE, on-prem) with a 'Show example' toggle.
ken: add a primary 'Re-run checks' button next to status so users can iterate without losing entered values. helper text: 'Rerun checks without clearing your setup.'
gary: UX nit: if a check is flaky (WARN), show a tooltip with what 'WARN' means and recommended tolerance.
sofia: vote: inline accordion for preflight + per-check inline remediation + collapsed advanced logs. react inline/sidepanel please.
mariah: inline
ken: sidepanel
gary: inline
sofia: inline wins. i'll update the spec and the figma to reflect an inline accordion with focus management, per-check remediations, error codes, and advanced diagnostics. i'll also add the copy updates and color contrast changes and post the updated link by EOD. :thumbsup:
